A '''skirmish''' took place on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[3643 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldier [[Dao Stryver]] attacked thugs affiliated with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] organization while searching for information regarding the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Cinzia]]''. Late in the battle, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shigar Konshi]] and the [[Republic trooper]]-turned-vigilante [[Larin Moxla]] simultaneously arrived on the scene. The duo was subsequently attacked by Stryver; however, after a fierce firefight, the Mandalorian escaped.<ref name="Fatal Alliance" />
